`final class AlAudioBridge`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IAudioBridge`](/reference/bridges/iaudiobridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.openal` · **Module:** `base-openal` · **Source:** [AlAudioBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/openal/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/openal/AlAudioBridge.java)

The audio bridge of OpenAL, whose streaming sources call OpenAL through a binding.

## Description

Create it with the binding of your library ([Create the bridge](/build/base-modules/openal/#create-the-bridge)).

## Properties

| [gain](#AlAudioBridge-property-gain) | [`AudioGain`](/reference/base-openal/audiogain/) | `(gain, group) -> gain` | The function that maps the gain and the audio group of a source to the volume sent to OpenAL; setting it updates every live source. |
| [ownContext](#AlAudioBridge-property-ownContext) | `boolean` | `true` | If `true`, the bridge creates an OpenAL context on the default device when the first source needs one and destroys it when the JVM exits; if `false`, the host owns the context. |

## Property details

<a id="AlAudioBridge-property-gain"></a>

### gain

- `this gain(AudioGain gain)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `AudioGain getGain()` 

**Default:** `(gain, group) -> gain`

The function that maps the gain and the audio group of a source to the volume sent to OpenAL; setting it updates every live source.

<a id="AlAudioBridge-property-ownContext"></a>

### ownContext

- `this ownContext(boolean ownContext)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `boolean isOwnContext()` 

**Default:** `true`

If `true`, the bridge creates an OpenAL context on the default device when the first source needs one and destroys it when the JVM exits; if `false`, the host owns the context.
